definitions.gloss: deportment; bearing; manners; the way one carries oneself
definitions.explanation: One's overall physical bearing and behavior, including posture, gestures, and general conduct. Covers both standing and sitting movements.

examples.japanese: {立|た}ち{居振|いふ}る{舞|ま}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
⟦{社会人|しゃかいじん}→社会人：13730_shakaijin⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立|た}ち{居振|いふ}る{舞|ま}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧につけたい。
examples.english: I want to develop proper manners as a working adult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立|た}ち{居振|いふ}る{舞|ま}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{育|そだ}ち→育ち：13927_sodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良|よ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦にじみ{出|で}て→にじみ出る：31773_nijimideru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: His bearing reveals his good upbringing.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{立|た}ち (standing) + {居|い} (sitting) + ⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧ (conduct). Literally "standing, sitting and behaving": the whole of how someone moves and carries themselves.

USAGE:
Somewhat formal; used when judging someone's bearing and manners, in talk of etiquette, training new employees, or describing a graceful person.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立|た}ち{居振|いふ}る{舞|ま}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧ (graceful deportment)
- {立|た}ち{居振|いふ}る{舞|ま}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧ (to mind one's manners)
- {立|た}ち{居振|いふ}る{舞|ま}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{身|み}につける (to learn proper deportment)
